conformance.item: Procedure 1: read the gap row in the triage note and the documents it names
Procedure 2: read the code narrowly, searching ids and names first
Procedure 3: use the web only for a cited public source
Procedure 4: report what the documents and code say and what is missing
Limits: read only, no writes or commands, stay in the working directory
Limits: work only on the G5 row
What to hand over: one-line gap_finding of at most 1,500 characters, ending with the ARTIFACT line, naming files with lines or ids
If you are blocked: BLOCKED line
